Collecting Orbs of Power grants Elemental buffs based on your equipped Super's element:
• <arc/>Arc: 1 <arc/>Bolt Charge Stack
• <solar/>Solar: <solar/>Restoration x1 for 5 seconds
• <void/>Void: 22.5 HP <void/>Overshield for 5 seconds
• <stasis/>Stasis: 2 <stasis/>Frost Armor Stacks for 9 seconds
• <strand/>Strand: <strand/>Woven Mail for 5 seconds
